model_annotation: The diagram, labeled "Abbildung 2", represents the exports and imports of goods as well as the trade balance of the USA. The x-axis is labeled with years from 2000 to 2024, marked at two-year intervals, and has a linear scale. The y-axis is labeled "in Mrd. US-Dollar" (in billion US dollars), ranging from -200 to 400 in increments of 50, also on a linear scale, with an additional axis on the right side ranging from -100 to 300 in increments of 50. Three lines are depicted: a blue line representing exports on the right scale, a red line representing imports on the right scale, and vertical blue bars indicating the trade balance on the left scale. The blue line (exports) starts at around 100 billion US dollars in 2000 and increases to approximately 300 billion US dollars by 2024, with some fluctuations. The red line (imports) begins at roughly 150 billion US dollars in 2000 and rises to about 340 billion US dollars by 2024, also with some fluctuations. The trade balance, represented by the blue bars, is mostly negative, indicating a trade deficit, and varies between approximately -150 billion US dollars and -200 billion US dollars throughout the period.
